incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-43821 - high p95 inference latency on compute-pool-eu-west. Alert rule: HighLatency95. Root ts=1778880012

alice: ack — I'm oncall, investigating. Any customer reports?

dmitri: I saw a short spike on autoscaler metrics and one node reported high GPU mem. Pulling runtime logs now.

carla: nginx 502 rate briefly increased for a few minutes, mostly from one IP range. Could be a regen load test.

alice: tailing logs — spike between 12:03:50 and 12:05:20 UTC then back to normal. No Intercom tickets so far.

sre-bot: Alert auto-resolved after 90s of no firing (policy: auto-resolve if condition not met). Note: this alert flapped twice in the last 10m.

alice: noted. Why did it re-fire? Is there a repeated restart or something?

dmitri: prom query I ran: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="runtime"}[2m])) by (le,instance))` — one instance hit ~1.2s then dropped back under 400ms.

carla: infra events show kubelet restarted pod `runtime-eu-3` at 12:03:55 (node drain/eviction). That matches timing.

alice: sounds like a rolling restart + warm-cache miss => transient latency. No visible customer impact.

oncall-next: passing handoff — I'll watch for another recurrence in the next 30m. Recommend we make a follow-up to tune alerts.

alice: creating follow-up ticket TICKET-1254 "Investigate flapping latency alert compute-pool-eu-west" and assigning to eng-oncall. Attaching logs + prom queries.

carla: proposal to reduce noise: require the condition to hold for 5m or exclude pods started < 10m ago. Example alert snippet: 
```
- alert: HighLatency95
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="runtime"}[2m])) by (le,instance)) > 0.8
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: warning
  annotations:
    summary: "Transient p95 latency > 800ms"
```

alice: :thumbsup: also adding a 3m PagerDuty dedupe window so we don't double page for the same short blip.

sre-bot: PagerDuty: PD-43821 auto-resolved (no escalation).

dmitri: will check overnight image digest refresh / node patch schedule. Suspect a kubelet restart kicked things.

eng-manager: thanks team — good quick triage. Please include follow-up in the weekly ops sync so we can adjust runbook.

alice: marking as "no customer impact" for now. Follow-ups: TICKET-1254 (investigate), ALERT-TUNE-332 (rule tuning).

carla: leaving :eyes: on the follow-up, will add a playbook note to ignore pods <10m old for this alert.

alice: handing off to @oncall-next, closing live thread. :white_check_mark:"
